name: Hotaru Ehon
description: Hotaru Ehon — a picture-book illustrator theme set like a poster: under a formal top header (studio name, menu and the Commission a book button in one bar, a full-screen imayo overlay on phones and tablets) the home page opens with the title in giant type across the whole width, and a picture-book map of the riverside village overlapping it with three glowing firefly pins, the places where books began. Imayo (#D0576B), the old Japanese "fashionable" pink, is the main colour: the hero, the story band and every page head are imayo fields set in dark ink. The hero breaks the frame: a cut-out firefly jar (transparent WebP) breaks out of the map frame over its top edge and into the giant title; a cut-out fox with a picture book breaks over the story band and every page head. Every picture is a flat 2D illustration in imayo pink, indigo night, cream and firefly yellow. Cherry Bomb One for display (with a Zen Maru Gothic kanji subset in Japanese), Quicksand for reading, Noto Sans TC for Traditional Chinese headings. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b4-16 (poster-typographic, scene-map hero, top-bar nav, cutout-break-frame, 2d-flat, imayo #D0576B, Cherry Bomb One + Quicksand, arts-media). A formal top header with the studio name, the menu and the Commission a book button in one bar. Cherry Bomb One has kana but few kanji, so Japanese headings add a Zen Maru Gothic kanji subset. White on imayo is only 3.99:1, so all small text on the imayo fields is dark ink. Vertical type only in Chinese and Japanese; Latin text stays horizontal. Break-frame: the cut-out firefly jar breaks out of the map frame and into the giant title, the cut-out fox over the story band and every page head.

summary.zh-TW: 今樣粉紅的繪本插畫工作室：巨大海報字標題、帶螢火蟲圖釘的村落地圖，去背螢火蟲罐破框而出，含五種語言樣本。
summary.en: An imayo-pink picture-book studio: giant poster type, a village map with firefly pins and a cut-out jar breaking the frame.
summary.ja: 今様色の絵本工房。大きなポスター文字、蛍のピンが光る村の地図、枠を越える切り抜きの蛍の瓶。
summary.fr: Un atelier d’albums rose imayo : typo d’affiche géante, carte du village aux lucioles et bocal détouré qui sort du cadre.
summary.de: Ein Bilderbuch-Atelier in Imayo-Rosa: riesige Plakatschrift, Dorfkarte mit Glühwürmchen-Pins, freigestelltes Glas über dem Rahmen.
